roi_formulas.labor_saved_hours: eligible_cases * (manual_minutes_per_case - assisted_minutes_per_case) / 60 - QA_minutes / 60; avoid double counting
roi_formulas.labor_value: labor_saved_hours * fully_loaded_hourly_cost; value unknown until A0 supplies data
roi_formulas.cost_per_qualified_lead: approved_campaign_spend / distinct_consent_based_qualified_leads; undefined when denominator=0 or attribution policy absent
roi_formulas.campaign_efficiency: qualified_leads_attributed / approved_campaign_spend; not computable absent policy/spend
roi_formulas.total_incremental_cost: infra_delta + provider_inference + media_render + connector_subscription + review_labor + approved_campaign_spend
roi_formulas.net_roi: (attributable_incremental_margin + defensible_labor_value - total_incremental_cost) / total_incremental_cost; undefined for zero or unknown cost
